name: univer
description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
one_liner: A free, open-source engine that lets any company bolt a working spreadsheet and document editor, like a mini Excel and Word, straight into their own app.
buyer: A SaaS founder or product manager building a vertical business app (finance ops, logistics, HR) who needs real spreadsheet editing inside their product without licensing Microsoft or Google.
business_use_cases: A logistics SaaS embeds a live spreadsheet view so warehouse managers can edit shipment plans directly inside the app instead of exporting to Excel.
An accounting firm builds a client portal where clients fill in editable financial templates in-browser, with changes syncing straight into the firm's backend.
An EdTech company adds collaborative spreadsheet assignments to its platform so students can do data-analysis homework without leaving the site.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a hosted, managed version of Univer (auth, backups, support) to companies who don't want to run the open-source core themselves
Build and sell industry-specific templates and plugins (budgeting, inventory, grading) on top of the SDK
Offer paid integration/consulting to help mid-size SaaS teams embed it in a few weeks

steal_this: This weekend, wire up Univer's spreadsheet component into a simple shared-budget tool for small teams and sell it as a $15/month alternative to a shared Google Sheet with structure baked in.
